task: Identify the steps to convert a PyTorch model to TensorFlow using the Hugging Face Transformers library as described in their documentation.
answer: According to the Hugging Face Transformers documentation guide 'How to convert a 🤗 Transformers model to TensorFlow?' (https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/add_tensorflow_model), assuming the TensorFlow model architecture is available in 🤗 Transformers, converting PyTorch weights into TensorFlow weights is done in three steps: (1) Make sure you are logged into your Hugging Face account in your terminal using 'huggingface-cli login' (access tokens available in your account settings); (2) Run 'transformers-cli pt-to-tf --model-name foo/bar', where foo/bar is the name of the model repository containing the PyTorch weights you want to convert; (3) Tag @joaogante and @Rocketknight1 in the 🤗 Hub PR that the command created. If a small output mismatch occurs, the pt-to-tf CLI offers a --max-error flag to override the error message at weight conversion time.
